title: Evaluating English-Korean Literary Machine Translations: A Dataset Featuring the RULER and VERSE Annotation Methods

live_model.evidence: "All VERSE questions were generated by gpt-4o-2024-05-13 model (the quality was assessed by human inspection)".

prompt.note: Used only to draft VERSE evaluation-question items during dataset construction; the generation prompt is not printed.

claim.metric: none (generated items were checked qualitatively by human inspection, not scored numerically)

data.source: RULER/VERSE annotated English-Korean literary MT dataset introduced in this paper

notes: gpt-4o-2024-05-13 is a dataset-construction tool here (generating candidate VERSE questions later human-vetted), not the subject of a benchmarked task; the paper's central contribution is the RULER/VERSE annotation dataset and methodology itself, evaluated on (other) MT systems, not on this model.
